description: Independent expert reference chain for the AUV case study, regenerated and audited against each MALCOMp stage system prompt, chain-of-thought rule asset, few-shot example, checker rule, trace schema, Emfatic/Ecore, executable EOL, and the supplied RoboChart grammar.
independent_design_decisions: Factored the common interface reference of RoboticPlatform and Controller into abstract Component.
Used abstract Type for PrimitiveType and CompositeType references.
Preserved Intpus in term extraction and normalised it to Inputs in the architecture model.
Left architecture parameters unnamed when the requirements provide only their types.
Interpreted LRE-Beh4 vel as hvel and general obstacle distance as odist.
Interpreted LRE-Beh11 according to vertical semantics using vvel and vdist.

checks: All 83 term entries use exact source requirement text, cover all 20 architecture GIDs, contain every unique quoted instance occurrence, and emit each Concept only once.
Term descriptions contain no independently invented domain definitions.
Official Eclipse Emfatic parsing completed with no errors or warnings.
EOL parsing succeeded and execution recreated result_AUV.model with the same SHA-256 digest.
All 20 architecture requirements are covered by 66 DSL trace entries and 122 model trace entries using the exact Json_Generator schemas.
Every DSL trace feature exists in Ecore and every model trace fact exists in EOL.
The architecture model contains 47 objects and all cross-references resolve.
All 41 behaviour requirements are covered by reference_traceability.json.
All 18 transition requirements are covered by result_behaviour_extraction.json.
result_behaviour.txt defines all eight used events and MALCOMj RoboChartTextParser extracted 5 nodes and 18 transitions.
Every architecture symbol referenced by result_behaviour.txt exists in result_AUV.model.
scope_limitations: RoboChartTextParser validates only machine, node, and transition endpoint structure.
No full Xtext cross-reference linking was executed.
No CSP/FDR behavioural model checking or reachability analysis was executed.
documented_assumptions: Intpus is a typo for Inputs.
LRE-Beh11 should follow its vertical prose semantics.
The local RoboChart function parameter o follows the exact example supplied by the state-machine prompt.
